ROCKET STAR / PURPOSE

Send the signal
beyond the ground.

Build an orbital communication layer for places where terrestrial networks cannot reach.

WHAT IT DOES

Orbit sends it.
avocadoMini receives it.

Rocket Star transmits a signal from orbit to compatible avocadoMini hardware. RockstarOS is intended to activate and manage the connection after the receiver, network, and required approvals are ready.
